pkgmetadata.longdescription: ForgeTrain is an LLM pretraining framework built end-to-end by an autonomous AI agent loop. It targets NVIDIA H100 GPUs and delivers 44.13% MFU (about 10% above Megatron-LM) for MiniCPM4-0.5B and 8B models. Features include CuTeDSL custom GEMM kernels, a self-built FlashAttention implementation, CUDA Graph support, and Triton fused kernels. This package installs the training-engine-tensor library (MiniCPM4-0.5B variant).
